title: Stack sizes
body:
A lot of items have new stack sizes, and many of them go beyond 64. Let us know if any of them feel wrong.

* Quite a few items have smaller stacks for balancing reasons
* Most items that stack to 256 do so because of crafting: 256 individual bricks make 64 brick blocks, and so on
